reviewer: Codex, agent-assisted screenshot and diff review

baselines.review: Existing reviewed macOS fixture; retained without modification.

Reviewed actual, expected and diff images. Four regions, canonical and overridden text, reset fallback, images, SVGs, colors, borders and spacing match. Cross-platform differences are confined to text rasterization and the resulting text-sized button edge. No content is missing or clipped.

limitations: Platform-specific visual references, not a relaxed pixel threshold.
Agent-assisted visual review is not human accessibility certification or screen-reader testing.
Unreviewed platforms have no fallback golden and remain blocked.
